players.product: power transformers, GIS / circuit breakers, EHV power cable (up to 400kV) and copper / aluminum rod

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 08-11-2026, consolidated): H1 revenue KRW 1,143,515M vs KRW 980,248M in H1 2025; H1 operating profit KRW 122,725M vs KRW 71,650M; H1 net profit KRW 85,848M vs KRW 49,122M. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 637,385M (Q2 2025: KRW 522,820M), operating profit KRW 71,962M (Q2 2025: KRW 37,606M). Segments: cable revenue KRW 814,908M (H1 2025: KRW 770,578M) with operating profit KRW 40,018M (KRW 27,789M); heavy electrical equipment (transformers, GIS, breakers) revenue KRW 327,233M (KRW 207,894M) with operating profit KRW 82,475M (KRW 43,402M). Exports KRW 383,464M; Americas revenue KRW 174,141M. US sales subsidiary ILJIN Electric USA posted revenue KRW 113,583,664 thousand and operating profit KRW 12,021,764 thousand (H1 2025: loss of KRW 2,598,663 thousand).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue KRW 1,143,515M (H1 2025 KRW 980,248M); H1 OP KRW 122,725M (H1 2025 KRW 71,650M); Q2 revenue KRW 637,385M, Q2 OP KRW 71,962M; heavy electrical OP KRW 82,475M on revenue KRW 327,233M

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog at 06-30-2026 (orders less 2026 sales): USD 1,939,091 thousand in total -- heavy electrical (transformers etc.) USD 1,290,131 thousand, of which overseas USD 1,040,365 thousand, and power cable USD 648,960 thousand, of which overseas USD 429,831 thousand. Customer advances (contract liabilities) rose to KRW 435,944,759 thousand from KRW 283,936,887 thousand at the start of the year.
quarterly_data.figure: Backlog USD 1,939,091 thousand (heavy electrical USD 1,290,131 thousand; cable USD 648,960 thousand); advances KRW 435,944,759 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Disclosed supply contracts in progress (section XI-1): transformer supply contracts booked through the US subsidiary ILJIN Electric USA -- a long-term contract of USD 332,475,000 (KRW 431,785,282,500; 2023-11-24 to 2028-12-31) whose deliveries began in April 2026, a USD 137,746,309 contract (KRW 197,652,178,784; 2026-01-02 to 2029-12-31) with deliveries from 2029, and a CAD 47,936,634 contract (KRW 51,822,856,918; 2026-04-06 to 2028-12-31) with deliveries from 2028 and a 26% advance already received. The report describes the first as a 5-year (2026-2030) EHV transformer supply deal with a US energy company, the second as a US power producer and the Canadian awards as from a Canadian power producer. Cable projects: Singapore Power (SP Group) NDC418 230kV cable supply and installation SGD 94,034,741.06 (KRW 108,696,637,886; 2026-05-11 to 2028-12-31, deliveries from Q3 2027), SP Group NDC369 230kV KRW 75,059,514,651 and NDC312 HV cable KRW 94,943,240,857, Kuwait MEW 300kV XLPE cable KRW 128,181,158,700, Bahrain EWA 400kV feeder cable KRW 168,501,313,879 and Bangladesh (Larsen & Toubro) HV cable KRW 82,139,575,967; plus a KRW 110,081,000,000 Yeonggwang solar EPC contract (2026-06-05 to 2028-07-20).
quarterly_data.figure: US transformer contracts USD 332,475,000, USD 137,746,309 and CAD 47,936,634; SP Group NDC418 SGD 94,034,741.06 (KRW 108,696,637,886)

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and utilisation, H1 2026 (value basis): transformers (Hongseong) produced KRW 251,813M against capacity of KRW 250,000M and circuit breakers (Hwaseong) KRW 88,235M against KRW 65,000M -- the company says both exceeded capacity through overtime, taking heavy-electrical utilisation to 108.0%. Bare conductor rod (Ansan) produced KRW 718,526M of KRW 740,081M capacity (97.1%) and power and insulated cable (Hwaseong) KRW 207,731M of KRW 209,809M (99.0%); overall utilisation 99.7%. In the report the company describes a structural North American upcycle (over 70% of large US transformers more than 25 years old) and AI data-center demand driving new orders for EHV transformers and switchgear, with shortages bringing price rises and growing backlogs.
quarterly_data.figure: Heavy-electrical utilisation 108.0% (transformers KRW 251,813M vs KRW 250,000M capacity); cable 99.0%; rod 97.1%; overall 99.7%

quarterly_data.signal: Product mix, H1 2026: copper and aluminium rod (SCR) KRW 498,588M (43.60%), power and insulated cable KRW 188,408M (16.48%), heavy electrical products (GIS, transformers, switchgear) KRW 311,681M (27.26%), cable construction KRW 73,025M (6.39%). EHV cable prices: domestic KRW 46,890 thousand per ton (FY2025: KRW 33,428 thousand) and export KRW 68,619 thousand per ton (FY2025: KRW 60,697 thousand). Raw materials: copper cathode bought domestically KRW 252,099M (40.60%, LS MnM and others) and imported KRW 308,084M (49.62%, Codelco and others); aluminium ingot KRW 23,896M domestic (Kistron and others) and KRW 16,603M imported (Marubeni and others); silicon steel for transformers KRW 20,217M (3.26%, POSCO and others).
quarterly_data.figure: SCR rod KRW 498,588M (43.60%); cable KRW 188,408M (16.48%); heavy electrical KRW 311,681M (27.26%); copper cathode KRW 252,099M domestic + KRW 308,084M imported

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) was the only customer above 10% of consolidated revenue in H1 2026 -- KRW 221,632,304 thousand, 19.38% (H1 2025: KRW 136,543,478 thousand, 13.93%). In the parent-only accounts the US subsidiary ILJIN Electric USA took KRW 92,687,260 thousand (8.26%). KEPCO-related risk: a public-sector bid-participation restriction and cancellation of qualified-supplier registration for some 170kV breakers over a GIS bid-rigging case (the customer's 2024 sales to Iljin were KRW 269,528,705,721) remain suspended by court order pending the first-instance ruling, and a criminal trial under the Fair Trade Act is in progress.
quarterly_data.figure: KEPCO KRW 221,632,304 thousand (19.38% of revenue); H1 2025 13.93%

quarterly_data.signal: Capex and R&D: 2026 investment plan of 670 (KRW 100 million units) for maintenance, test equipment and R&D -- cable 254 and heavy electrical 416 -- of which 74 was spent in H1 and 596 remains; H1 PP&E purchases KRW 6,846,992 thousand. R&D spend KRW 5,184M (0.45% of revenue). Development record: 420kV 4000A 63kA 50Hz GIS, 362kV 6300A 63kA 60Hz GIS, 29kV eco-friendly railway GIS, KEPCO 154kV high-efficiency vegetable-oil transformer, 154kV synthetic-oil transformer, 345kV variable shunt reactor, 320kV HVDC cable PQ completed (KEMA) and 154kV polypropylene-insulated cable.
